terraces._doc: ground MACRO elevation (owner redirect §E): the two CROWN TERRACES — raised platinum plateaus on the north wings (behind the west / east bridges), 0.5 m up, with 6 m walkable ramps on the south edge (from the bridge landings) and on the inner edge (from the market approach). Host: one walkable BOX + RAMPs per terrace (worldLayout.terraceColliders, generated); client: terrain.js draws the slab / ramps / lip and every placed thing on a terrace (trees, fixtures, shards, paths, monolith, the region tint) stands on it through worldLayout.groundYAt.

tree_lock._doc: owner redirect TREE LOCK: the trunk and main boughs are clean platinum / heat-grey METAL (no wood, no green, no glow); crystal only at the extremities (twig tips / leaf clusters) in the REGION family; the crystal foliage never exceeds the extremity band. Implemented in the tree material shader (radial distance from the trunk axis + height → metal ↔ crystal blend), per instance colour = the region family. No mesh edit (BLENDER SLOT RESERVED).

sky._doc: layered sky (owner redirect §F + M5 owner correction OP08): low/mid/high sheets drift on ONE world wind vector; one bounded optical-density sample on each stable celestial direction consistently attenuates disc, halo, rays and key.

celestial_optics.note: phone-safe analytic cloud coverage; the foreground shaped veil uses the same phase and transmission as the real DirectionalLight hook

layers.note: M6: long, low old-soft cloud banks; depth-tested and depth-writing so terrain / structures and nearer cloud bodies establish real occlusion

M8B sky realism: a ring of large, flatter cumulus banks behind the far massifs (820-1100 m) — scale and depth at the horizon; lit bodies like the low / mid layers but outside the Sun / Moon optics (they never cross the high celestial bodies)

M8D cloud realism: towering cumulus (congestus) on a CAMERA-RELATIVE ring 1060-1200 m out, rising behind the far massifs (620-860 m) — the scale the sky lacked. Bank: outside the Sun / Moon optics; based above the HALO deck height and always > 1 km from the viewer, so no body can reach the upper realm; the ring keeps 26 deg clear of the Sun and Moon azimuths (the lavender Moon stays unobstructed); effectively static (distant towers barely move)

atmosphere._doc: owner B7 §8 (2026-09-20): the phone-safe physically-inspired sky (lab/world/atmosphere.js) — a Rayleigh-style zenith → horizon mix by the optical depth of the view ray, a horizon haze band warmed toward the sun, a Henyey-Greenstein Mie lobe (the sun glare + halo), a graphite ground haze, a faint cool-violet MAHWORLD zenith cast; the scene fog takes the haze colour (one truth for sky + distance falloff). Tiers: HIGH / MED full, LOW = Mie lobe off. The oversized sun / moon canon (registry.celestial) and the water stay.
atmosphere.m8b_note: M8B sky realism (2026-09-25): deeper zenith, milky horizon over ~30 deg, whiter sun glow; night indigo zenith, purple-blue horizon and a strong lavender lunar aureole (mie 0.22 -> 0.55)
atmosphere.pivot_note: World pivot PASS 1 (owner sky direction 2026-09-25): bright fantasy DAYLIGHT is the hero: a luminous horizon, a warm gold glow toward the Sun, and a lavender band on the anti-solar horizon that ties the sky to the lavender Moon; NIGHT keeps the same language in a deep indigo register.

time_of_day._doc: Owner sky direction 2026-09-25 (supersedes the Astra M3 night-first default): bright fantasy DAYLIGHT is the primary presentation. Two STABLE states (no calendar / simulation). DAY is the first-visit default and route preview; an explicit ?sky=night or the player saved choice still wins. Both states keep the actual Sun and Moon, are prewarmed before play and remain live-switchable through fieldScene.setNight.

ecology._doc: FISH: deep water beyond the beach ring (the sea) + the sanctuary water bodies, schools that swim under the surface and BREACH; when provoked they fight (SWIM → BREACH → HOVER → SWIRL → BODY LAUNCH → RETURN) · HORSE: the open range near the class house, solitary, walk / trot / graze, non-aggressive, reacts when struck · PHOENIX: the aerial highlands near the flight ceiling (100 m), rare, patrol circuits, engages flyers / attackers with anticipated dives · DOGKIE: the forests, the baseline introductory enemy. Owner next-pass 2026-09-20: every species is a HOST combatant (play/world/WildlifeManager.js + DogkieManager.js) balanced by the DATA below against the STANDARD BASELINE PLAYER ATTACK (rules damage.baseline_player_attack); the client only presents. No payment UI.

baseline._doc: hits_to_kill = how many baseline player hits (ATHLETE PA_PUSH, applied vs the creature profile) the creature survives; hits_to_kill_player = how many creature hits defeat a baseline ATHLETE player (1000 HP). RulesField.spawnSynthetic turns these into absolute HP and a per-creature damage multiplier at spawn — never numbers inside animations.

population_lod._doc: owner B7 §9 (2026-09-20): perceived density ≈ 3× the host presentation through client-side population LOD (lab/world/wildlife.js buildPopulation) — NEAR / COMBAT = the host entities (pool below: targetable, breach / hover / swirl / launch); MID = cheap instanced school agents cruising every pond / canal + sea schools around the coast with occasional breaches (splash + ripple impulse); FAR = instanced deep-water silhouettes. Counts scale with the quality tier (LOW ×0.5, MED ×0.75). Ambient only: no host state, no damage, no lock.
